scope: Pre-score training-only six-class auxiliary metadata preparation; no audio modification or playback.
class_policy: Keep every original positive source as target; only exact standalone Hey Nick/Next/Nice/Mix/Nexus negatives receive auxiliary text classes. Other negatives remain in unchanged main binary sampling.
